scope: Descriptive saved ordinary observations: baseline alpha=5e-7 versus new alpha=2.5e-7, with the other physical conditions fixed by the execution protocol. Historical baseline loading was composed from separately solved segments; the new case is one zero-start load-only run. Original source legs, accepted bisection states, residuals and computational work are retained. No interpolation, alpha-independent gate, pressure, effective clamp, stability, release, full-path-reference or HF5 qualification is introduced. An old reference does not qualify the new alpha.
physical_context: r9 mm; centre (80,40) mm; right92 mm; Lr80 mm; lower-half model

baseline_source.scope: Existing saved ordinary observations only. Chronological display across fourteen separately solved segments is not one complete solve or full-path independent reference. Original origin/resume_origin/loading/unloading legs and all source accepts/diagnostics are retained. Signed lower-body weak forces are not circular local pressure or qualified effective grip; q_out is a weighted port displacement, not a gap; Q1 distances are unsigned raster-boundary diagnostics, not analytic-circle signed gaps. No new force/tangent/HP/equilibrium/tests/default changes/API association, zero/recovery/energy/stability criterion or qualification. Whole-model Hu is not available in these inputs and is not inferred from medium Hu.
baseline_source.counts_scope: Historical whole-path counts are source context, not loading-only CPU costs.

definition.selection: Actual resident body-right/domain-right define fixed reference IDs; never reselected by deformed x

plot_notes: Every recorded Newton base check is shown, in source order, with no filtering.
Groups are inferred from target changes/counter restarts; an attempt failing before its first base check has no group.
Symlog axes preserve exact zero. Linear thresholds change axis display only; no residual is clipped or replaced.
Accepted-state markers use zero-based chronological state index, with sparse ticks also showing actual d in mm; loading and unloading at equal d remain separate. No interpolated mechanical states.
The residual tolerance comes from saved settings. Global force balance is a separate dimensionless diagnostic; no new acceptance gate is inferred.
Constraint residual magnitude and its saved bound are in mm, on a separate panel.
Rejected Armijo/backtracking trials are internal bounded solver work, not an external retry.
Production convergence alone does not grant independent-reference, contact-pressure, or effective-clamping qualification.

reference_scope: Only original historical states retain their existing reference; new alpha has no new HP reference.
cost_scope: Segmented baseline versus one zero-start run; total counts or CPU time are not a pure-alpha performance comparison.
